ramify 1
module harness
owned-nested-project "fixtures/capability-coordination"
owned-nested-project "fixtures/capability-coordination-nested"
owned-nested-project "fixtures/collection-review"

// The server for one project, which the root starts with the web client's
// build output. Runs, their records, plan discovery, the evidence the
// analysis works from and the HTTP adapter stay internal.
expose-src startCliServer, CliServerOptions, CliServer, ProjectRootError from "http/server.ts" to parent
expose-src isProjectLockError from "store/lock.ts" to parent

// One engineer session on one module, from a prompt, which the root's
// `session` command runs and prints. The command's entry builds the agent
// and the Ramify command line itself, so the agent port, the Ramify command
// line and the run policy stay internal. The named types the summary
// mentions are exposed with it, since a symbol's signature is part of what
// its receiver must be able to name.
expose-src runSessionCommand, SessionCommandOptions, SessionAgentChoice from "sessions/command.ts" to parent
expose-src SingleSessionResult, SessionSummary, SessionProgress, SessionGateResult from "sessions/single.ts" to parent
expose-src EngineerSubmission, engineerSubmissionSchema from "work/engineer.ts" to parent
expose-src HookFinding from "hooks/post-write.ts" to parent
expose-src InvocationOutcome, invocationOutcomeSchema from "run/records.ts" to parent

// The root's `step` command: importing one invocation's recorded inputs from
// a run, and rendering what a step's session receives. The constructor, the
// inputs schema and the rendering stay internal; the root receives the plain
// options it parses and the text it prints.
expose-src runStepCommand, StepCommandOptions, StepCommandResult from "steps/command.ts" to parent
expose-src runConsultationsCommand, ConsultationCommandOptions, ConsultationCommandResult from "consultations/command.ts" to parent
expose-src runRepairExportCommand, RepairExportCommandOptions, RepairExportCommandResult from "run/repair-export-command.ts" to parent
expose-src RepairExportConfiguration from "run/repair-export.ts" to parent
expose-test rootDescription from "helpers/root-description.ts" to descendants

// The public contracts of the behavior this module implements: the
// vocabulary of the evidence a run works from, and the HTTP protocol it
// serves. Each file imports nothing but `zod` and its sibling schemas, so
// every export promises browser safety and the root re-exposes it to the
// web client.
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/evidence.ts" tagged [browser] to parent
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/ids.ts" tagged [browser] to parent
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/queries.ts" tagged [browser] to parent

expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/capability-tasks.ts" tagged [browser] to parent

// The run protocol, beside the job protocol this module already owns: the
// commands, the queries and every projection a client reads of a run.
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/runs.ts" tagged [browser] to parent

// The CheckFinding protocol, which the run protocol's commands include: the
// review coverage, the bounded lists, details and module counts of a run's
// CheckFindings, and a person's answer, waiver and revocation.
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/check-findings.ts" tagged [browser] to parent

// The session protocol: the entries of a transcript as the harness writes
// them, and the queries that list sessions, follow their transcripts and
// fetch their bodies.
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/transcripts.ts" tagged [browser] to parent
expose-src * from "interfaces/protocol/sessions.ts" tagged [browser] to parent

// The audit child proves conformance against commits made by the harness and
// verifies that publication does not disturb repository cleanliness. The git
// behavior and process execution remain owned by evidence; harness relays the
// narrow contracts the audit adapter implements rather than duplicating them.

// Repair authentication is run authority, independent of response presentation.
// Descendants receive committed inputs and validated facts, not writable services.
